messages:
deploy-bot: ✅ Deploy finished: inference-api v2.8.7 -> canary (us-west-2A) 3/3. Starting post-deploy smoke suite: kv-prefill, embed-synth, http-liveness. Posting results here.
jules: saw a brief p95 spike on embed-synth in the first minute, from ~2.1s -> ~3.9s. not widespread yet. tagging @sam @liam for traces.
sam: looking now — trace indicates a model-variant fallback on canary-2 that queued requests. grabbing logs.
liam: if that keeps up i'll halt rollouts. change window open until 03:00. what's the 5xx rate on the canary?
amanda: 5xx ~0.3% at 00:05, mostly 504s from the proxy layer. kv-prefill shows 2/3 hosts warmed, canary-2 lagging. :thinking_face:
sam: hotfix proposal: pin canary hosts to previous model on canary-2 only. command: `deployctl pin inference-api --hosts canary-2 --model v2.8.6`
jules: alternatively can we shift traffic off canary-2 for now? it's the one triggering fallbacks. @ops-bot can you route it to fallback pool?
ops-bot: ops-bot: routing change applied — canary-2 => fallback pool. updated weights: canary-0/1 = 100% of canary traffic. Health now shows 2/2.
amanda: after traffic shift p95 back to ~1.8s, 5xx down to 0.05%. KV warmup still finishing but not blocking. recommend continue rollout but hold autoscaler and any config changes.
liam: agreed. hold the rollout; no further host adds. Sam keep the pin command ready if it reappears. we'll monitor for 30m and reconvene if noisy.
sam: on it. uploaded a debugger snapshot: s3://redwood-debug/5067891234-canary2-dump.log
jules: adding note to release: "Canary observing model-variant fallback on canary-2; mitigated by isolating traffic to fallback pool and continuing rollout with gates. Monitor 30m." amanda please mark release tracker as "continued (gated)".
amanda: done. release tracker updated and added a follow-up ticket for deeper root cause. :thumbsup:
liam: thanks everyone. ping here if anything regresses.
